article.linkText: UAB hosts UTSA in AAC matchup
article.story: UTSA (8-2) at UAB (6-4), Nov. 21 at 8 p.m. EST. Opening Line: UTSA by 6.5. Against the spread: UTSA 6-4, UAB 5-4-1. How to watch: ESPNU Key stats UTSA Offense Overall: 402.5 yards per game (46th in FBS) Passing: 215.2 yards per game (83rd) Rushing: 187.3 yards per game (31st) Scoring: 33.2 points per game (28th) UTSA Defense Overall: 399.9 yards per game (114th in FBS) Passing: 208.5 yards per game (63rd) Rushing: 191.4 yards per game (122nd) Scoring: 28.4 points per game (101st) UAB Offense Overall: 336.8 yards per game (113th in FBS) Passing: 163.1 yards per game (129th) Rushing: 173.7 yards per game (47th) Scoring: 23.2 points per game (102nd) UAB Defense Overall: 292.9 yards per game (18th in FBS) Passing: 118.8 yards per game (1st) Rushing: 174.1 yards per game (104th) Scoring: 22.4 points per game (52nd) UAB is 116th in the FBS with a -6 turnover margin, compared to UTSA's 17th-ranked +6 margin. UTSA is 137th in the FBS averaging 83.3 penalty yards per game, compared to UAB's 48th-ranked 48.9 per-game average. UAB is 131st in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 93.5% of trips. UTSA's red zone offense ranks 42nd, scoring on 87.9% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders UTSA Passing: Owen McCown, 2,101 yards, 13 TDs, 5 INTs, 67.5 completion percentage Rushing: Will Henderson III, 752 yards on 134 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Mekhi Anderson, 449 yards on 38 catches, 5 TDs UAB Passing: Ryder Burton, 1,607 yards, 6 TDs, 9 INTs, 54.5 completion percentage Rushing: Roderick Robinson II, 753 yards on 144 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: C.J. Smith, 450 yards on 24 catches, 1 TD Last game UTSA won 35-16 over North Texas on Nov. 14. McCown threw for 85 yards on 15-of-24 attempts (62.5%) with no touchdowns and one interception. A'Marion Peterson carried the ball 11 times for 179 yards and scored four touchdowns. David Amador II had five receptions for 30 yards. UAB won 36-10 over Temple on Nov. 14. Burton threw for 133 yards on 11-of-19 attempts (57.9%) with no touchdowns and one interception. Robinson had 202 rushing yards on 22 carries and three touchdowns, adding one reception for two yards. Scott Isacks III had three receptions for 80 yards. Next game UTSA hosts Tulsa on Nov. 27. UAB plays at North Texas on Nov. 28.
